# Policymaker #108: start of iteration 0006

Trigger: 6 iterations without progress. Iteration 0005 ran 4 codex sessions (record `.session/history/records/0005.json`). Nothing merged.

Finding: #103 (reviewer, 12 turns, 855k), #104 and #106 (benchmark, 28 and 26 turns, 947k and 883k) all ended `partial/input_budget`, and #105 crashed with 0 turns. `.github/loop/role_runtime.py` stops a session once its unique input reaches 800k tokens. For codex, unique input is counted as `in - cache_read`. The cache_read share was only 5%, and every turn resends the whole history, so a codex session gets only about 12-28 turns. #104 still produced a working coverage generator and record in commit `c6830d1` (`benchmark/scripts/coverage.py`, `coverage.json`, `coverage.md`). That commit is not on any branch.

Changes:
- `policy/params.yml`: `benchmark` routing changed to Claude-first (`*implementation`). The engine treats Claude's `in` as already excluding cache reads, so a long history uses less of the budget. Reviewer and audit stay codex-first so review runs on a different model family. Expected effect: benchmark sessions finish under the budget. Check: turns and tokens of the 0006 benchmark session compared with #104 and #106.
- `.session/orders.json`, no wake:
  - `bench-coverage` (40 turns): restore `c6830d1`, verify it, set `coverage: prepared-not-reviewed`. The 83k-line JSON is not to be read. Expected gain: the second of seven milestones merged. Check: `python3 -I benchmark/scripts/coverage.py --check` exits 0 on the main line.
  - `review-sources` (12 turns): reviews only the `sources` row, writes early, and must give its recommendation by turn 10. Expected gain: a reviewed recommendation for the first milestone. Check: `.session/artifacts/review-sources.md` ends with `Recommendation: … at <commit>` and the session reports `done`.
- `policy/working-memory.md` now records this mechanism and the open questions.

Benchmark readiness is not established. Six milestones are still unreviewed and `native_labview` has not been executed. Tool quality is unmeasured.

## Discoveries
- Each order in 0005 was issued twice under the same id (issues 103/105 and 104/106) (`records/0005.json`, `tasks`).
- Output from partial sessions is not merged and stays on no branch, which loses work (`git branch -a --contains c6830d1` is empty).

## What next
- If `bench-coverage` reports `c6830d1` missing, submit an `engine-change` to preserve or merge partial-session commits.
- Do not re-investigate the input-budget cause. It is in working memory.
- Decide how a review recommendation moves a milestone to `reviewed` (owner gate) before ordering the next review.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
